basis: Parallel-session reconciliations 19125e0 (endpoint estimands + chronology audit) and 9c39bde (independent preflight readback verification); adopted without altering any frozen artifact of the V1 protocol file itself.

chronology_reconciliation.fact: The original registered A461 protocol predates the G-1 preflight by 4924 s; per 19125e0 the preflight does not retroactively gate that historical protocol, which remains DESIGNED_NOT_EXECUTED and is not modified by this round.
chronology_reconciliation.resolution: The V1 G0 protocol (commit 20898b8) plus this amendment constitute the post-preflight protocol revision; 19125e0 records that the NOVELTY_DELTA_TESTABLE preflight 'is a substantive new literature judgment usable for a future protocol revision'. No dates are backdated anywhere.
chronology_reconciliation.independent_review_status: Preflight readback independently verified in 9c39bde; 19125e0's own direct full-text reading of arXiv:2610.12292v1 (SS3-7,7.1,11) reached a compatible delta judgment (no published SecJev evidence-order monotonicity measurement) and adds the deterministic-rule competing baseline recorded below.

endpoint_structure_adoption.GOLD_CHANGING_RESPONSIVENESS: LANL_L1_B_THRESHOLD (R_old=0 -> R_new=1), TWINS_T1_QUORUM_AXIS (wait->accept), TWINS_T2_CONFLICT_AXIS (C 0->1 -> reject_conflict). Primary error: with a correct old-arm baseline, the new-arm prediction fails to match the independently recomputed new Gold.
endpoint_structure_adoption.GOLD_INVARIANT_RISK_NONREGRESSION: TWINS_T3_CONFLICT_STABILITY (add legal vote, Gold stays reject_conflict) and NEW LANL_L3A_RISK_NONREGRESSION below. Primary error: with a correct old-arm baseline, prediction leaves the unchanged investigate/reject_conflict Gold under valid risk-evidence addition.
endpoint_structure_adoption.GOLD_INVARIANT_NUISANCE: N1_NEUTRAL_APPEND and N2_GOLD_INVARIANT_TIMESTAMP_RETIMING. Primary error: prediction changes under Gold-invariant perturbation; raw margins reported separately and never pooled with the two risk-relevant endpoints.

baseline_eligibility: R=true in old arm (count_visible_failed_logons>=5 OR count_distinct_known_failed_destinations>=3); Gold investigate
at least one existing known failed destination in-window to append against
added_pair_family.edit: Append ONE prior event: failed LogOn (schema copy of an existing failed event) to an EXISTING known failed destination, seconds_before_current = deterministic unused in-window value by the same rule as LANL_L1; all other fields byte-identical
added_pair_family.registered_expectation: Nonregression: with correct old-arm baseline, new-arm prediction must remain investigate; leaving investigate under strengthened risk evidence is the primary error. Margin decreases are secondary only.
added_pair_family.budget_note: Drawn from the same 128-forward paired-pilot cap; pair counts adjusted at freeze time so total stays within cap.

semantic_guards_adopted: Failure-to-change in a Gold-changing pair is a rule-response failure, NOT by itself a sign-reversing monotonicity violation; the two are reported as separate outcome classes (responsive-correct / failed-to-change / wrong-direction).
Twins wait->accept and accept->reject are different rule axes and are never merged.
LANL investigate is informational triage, not permission denial; no allow/block vocabulary pooling across families.

WHY_USE_MODEL baseline: the deterministic rule oracle is an explicit non-model upper baseline in any paper claim; model-value discussion must identify where perception/extraction/generalization requires inference (per 19125e0 and arXiv:2610.12292 deterministic-rule finding).
no_other_changes: Pair construction rules, oracle definitions, negative controls N1/N2/N3, stop conditions, resource bounds, and DEV-only data boundary are unchanged from V1.
